head_commit.message:
refactor(industrials): move the denominator guard beside its vocabulary; free test_ind_r206

The W9 review of #9131 (ACCEPT_WITH_NITS) asked for two changes before merge.

The guard reads the result-to-cash vocabulary (business_dimensions,
revenue_share_pct, the perimeter rule) that engine/fundamental_forensics/
industrials_result_cash.py owns, and company_intelligence already imports
fundamental_forensics one way. Left in company_intelligence, the wiring
follow-up (qualify_operands calling denominator_refusal) would need the
reverse import. The module moves unchanged, before it has an importer; the
job's paths entry moves with it so the curated-exclusive closure check
still covers it.

The frozen plan reserves test_ind_r206 for T03's
tests/test_industrials_source_facts.py (requirement_index.md:96). The test
now uses a behaviour name and leaves the anchor name free.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

head_commit.message:
Consumer Cyclical: shared-contract review gate (refuses while the shared module is absent) (#9108)

* feat(consumer-cyclical): shared-contract review gate (refuses while the shared module is absent)

engine/sector_intelligence/consumer_cyclical_shared_contract.py gates the
Cyclical vertical on the shared theme-research contract. On main, where
the shared module is absent, it refuses; a strict-xfail positive
round-trip (tests/test_consumer_cyclical_shared_contract.py) flips when
the shared shell lands.

Built by Grok lane W6-B-CONSB (123 passed, 1 xfailed; contract delta
0/0; test_ci_pack 166 passed).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Consumer Cyclical: display packet over the projection; correct the #7870 citation

W8-B-CONSB (independent Grok lane, ACCEPT):
- engine/sector_intelligence/consumer_cyclical_display.py: display_packet refuses
  any fact with native_admitted true, then copies the projection lead and
  advertising_net_change with filing_claim false, provenance synthetic_fixture and
  shared_contract_status unavailable|present. The shared callable is not invoked.
- tests/test_consumer_cyclical_shared_contract.py: the curation_assertion citation
  now names 52b741c5082 (480eb2bd has no such file); strict xfail unchanged.
- consumer-cyclical-economic-change job lists the module and the new suite.

Lane gates: packs 0-11 rc=0; the three packing probes equal the base.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(consumer-cyclical): carry availability and withheld state on the display packet

The PLNT display packet copied the lead and the advertising value but dropped
the projection's own availability verdict, so a page mounting it could render
an unavailable document as a complete one. It also collapsed a withheld
advertising row and an absent one into the same bare None.

The packet now carries availability (anything outside ready/unavailable reads
unavailable), advertising_net_change_status (ready, withheld or absent) and
the row's withheld_reason. New pins cover the ready fixture, a withheld row on
an unavailable document, and an absent row with an unknown verdict, and lock
the packet's key set.

Closes the W10 review P2 (consumer_cyclical_display.py:106-113) and the
adjacent P3 (:76-83).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: Chris Wong <actions@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
